To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed an architecture that enables the representation and execution, in a behavior-based framework, of complex, sequential and hierarchically structured behaviors and plans.
we have developed an approach to implementing AI-level concepts into behavior-based systems, without compromising their key properties, and we have demonstrated the approach on a mobile robot.

(1) BBS can be extended to support hierarchical task representations, (2) this extension is achieved by introducing the notion abstract behaviors, and (3) the proposed hierarchical abstract behavior architecture is a suitable approach to implementing complex AI-level behaviors in BBS.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of BBS that have the potential for dealing with complex tasks.
the integration of AI-level concepts into behavior-based systems in a way that is consistent with the key properties of BBS.
the development of an approach to the integration of AI and BBS, in order to obtain a framework that is suitable for the development of complex, real-world robotic systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the hierarchical abstract behavior architecture is a very promising approach for implementing complex tasks in behavior-based robots.
the hierarchical architecture presented in this paper is a viable and effective way for implementing AI-level concepts within the framework of behavior-based robotics.
the hierarchical abstract behavior architecture is an efficient, flexible, and scalable solution to the problem of integrating hierarchical planning and execution in behavior-based robots.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the hierarchical architecture allows for the execution of complex, hierarchically organized tasks in behavior-based systems, without compromising their key properties, and without introducing any explicit representation of the environment.
the hierarchical architecture allows the robot to perform a wide variety of tasks in an efficient and robust fashion.
we are able to represent complex plans and execute them in a behavior-based fashion, while maintaining the key properties of behavior-based systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to combine the benefits of behavior-based systems with those of more classical planning approaches, without compromising either of the two.
BBS and hierarchical planning can be combined to form a powerful, general-purpose, and flexible framework for implementing intelligent behavior in complex, real-world environments.
the behavior-based paradigm is a viable framework for implementing AI-level planning and learning capabilities.
